sources_chirho.license_chirho: WLC text: public domain. OSHB lemmas and morphology: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
sources_chirho.attribution_chirho: Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb. Adapted here: every verse read into one canonical line: word-division slashes removed, XML whitespace written as single spaces, each ketiv kept in the line with its qere attached, paragraph letters, editorial, exegesis and alternative-accent notes and the KJV verse numbers recorded beside the line, and morphology codes decoded into English labels and teaching categories. No endorsement is implied.

sources_chirho.title_chirho: Global Bible Tools English glosses, Genesis (eng/01-Gen.json)
sources_chirho.license_chirho: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), dedicated by Global Bible Tools itself. In globalbibletools/platform@5d4041d4, src/ui/study/components/AttributionDialog.tsx gives the glosses of every language except English New Testament the use {type: "self", licenseCode: "cc0_1_0"}, which src/messages/en.json renders as "English Glosses by Global Bible Tools are available under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal". Only English New Testament glosses (Alan Bunning, CNTR) are "used with permission"; this is an Old Testament file, GBT's own export of 2026-01-26. The globalbibletools/data repository carries no LICENSE file; the dedication is GBT's published statement in its platform. Checked 2026-10-27 (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md).
